_comment: Recorded shapes from a box worker host: the mesh advert as meshAdvertJson emits it, the body of a GitHub GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runners/{id} 200 response, and the controller container as listWorkerContainers reports it. Digests are the two release images the tests move between. The realizer has no HTTP surface: it reads runner presence only through the typed jobs.runners() port (status and busy), whose adapter owns the GitHub call, its status, headers and auth, so only body shapes are recorded here; the transport the tests pass throws on any call.
